findings.description: Using 'type(delta) is not int' correctly distinguishes Python integers from booleans (which are instances of int) and floats, strictly adhering to the contract's type exclusion rules.
Reading 'sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)' bounds memory consumption immediately and allows exact enforcement of the 131072-byte limit without reading unbounded streams.

Catching (ValueError, RecursionError) uniformly covers JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, custom validation rejections, and deeply nested input recursion, guaranteeing clean atomicity and the required exit 2 diagnostic.
Documentation in README.md and criteria in criteria.md satisfy the contract requirements for environment, interface, limits, examples, errors, atomicity, and test invocation.

result.reason: The implementation and documentation strictly satisfy all contract requirements, including exact aggregation, duplicate-key rejection, delta type and bound enforcement, byte-limit enforcement, and atomic batch output.
